title: Lantern and Uniform
author: Freya Okafor
blurb: Sable Eriksen, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the census taker asks one question too many, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
